description: This Dart source file defines a class AppCacheManagers that manages cache configurations for thumbnail and full-size images in a Flutter application, utilizing the flutter_cache_manager package. It provides static methods to access different cache managers with specific configurations tailored for image sizes and cache eviction policies.

classes.name: AppCacheManagers
classes.description: A utility class providing static access to cache manager instances for thumbnails and full-size images, with custom configurations for each.

methods.name: AppCacheManagers.thumbnails
methods.description: Returns the CacheManager instance configured for thumbnail images, with a shorter stale period and higher cache object limit.

methods.name: AppCacheManagers.fullSize
methods.description: Returns the CacheManager instance configured for full-size images, with a longer stale period and fewer cache objects.
